name: Paw Prints
source:
In "Paw Prints", you'll play as an aspiring writer who turns to their dreams for ideas. With only 2 weeks left and a completely blank script, will you make it in time to join the contest and get published?

[Edited from [url=https://colorpuff.itch.io/paw-prints]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在“Paw Prints”中，你将扮演一位有抱负的作家，向梦想寻求灵感。只剩两周时间，剧本完全空白，你能及时参加比赛并发表吗？

[编辑自[url=https://colorpuff.itch.io/paw-prints]itch.io[/url]]
